en.title: Spring Dust and the Tiny Droplets of the Nagaya
en.premise: In a beautiful spring where cherry blossoms dance, an unexpected drought strikes the tenement houses of Edo, leaving wells to run dry one by one. Amidst the desperation of the townspeople, a mysterious merchant from a desert land arrives, draped in exotic scents. Calling his small cart 'The Desert Oasis,' he shares wisdom on surviving with limited water and offers mysterious sweets that soothe parched souls. A story of bringing a rain of mercy—in the form of human kindness—to a withered town.

zh.title: 春风沙尘与长屋微滴
zh.premise: 樱花漫舞的美丽之春，一场突如其来的旱灾袭击了江户的长屋，水井接连干涸。就在町人们陷入困境之时，一位据说来自沙漠之国的奇特商人，带着异域的香气悄然现身。他将自己的小货车称为“沙漠绿洲”，不仅传授在有限水源下生存的智慧，还带来了能滋润干涸心灵的神奇点心。这是一个在枯竭的小镇上，降下名为“人情”的恩惠之雨的故事。
